استنبئا (form X)
# اُسْتُنْبِئَا (ustunbiʔā) /us.tun.bi.ʔaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# اِسْتَنْبِئَا (istanbiʔā) /is.tan.bi.ʔaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
